study_identification_part.si_4_title: GPT-based normative models of brain sMRI correlate with dimensional psychopathology

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD); Brazilian High-Risk Cohort Study (BHRCS); ADHD-200 Sample; Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE-II)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The studied datasets contain measures of dimensional psychopathology: Brazilian High- Risk Cohort Study (BHRCS, n = 737) and Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD, n = 11,031), and scores and diagnostic of psychiatric disorders: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD- 200, n = 922) and Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE- II, n = 580).

answer.BHRCS: test set for clinical research (correlation with CBCL)

answer.ADHD-200: test set for clinical research (correlation with ADHD scores)

answer.ABIDE-II: test set for clinical research (ASD diagnosis)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABCD was split into training (n=6,756), validation (n=751), and testing (n=3,524). BHRCS, ADHD-200, and ABIDE-II were fully reserved for testing as out-of-sample datasets.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training ( n= 6,756), validation ( n= 751), and testing ( n= 3,524) purposes. ... The ABCD test set ( n= 3,524) and the complete datasets of ABIDE-II ( n= 580), ADHD-200 ( n= 922), and BHRCS ( n= 737) were reserved for the evaluation procedure (i.e., final tests).

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Training phase used 6,756 typical subjects from ABCD. Overall phase (train + validation + test HC) includes 6,756 (train) + 751 (validation) + 834 (ABCD test HC) + 512 (BHRCS TD) + 565 (ADHD-200 TD) + 329 (ABIDE-II TD) = 9,747 HC. ABCD test HC (834) was calculated as 10% of total normal CBCL subjects (8341).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training ( n= 6,756), validation ( n= 751), and testing ( n= 3,524) purposes. ... we assigned 10% of the normal and 100% of the high CBCL subjects to the test set. From the remaining 90% of normal CBCL subjects, one-tenth of the examples were assigned to validation and nine-tenths to the training set.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: For train-phase, ABCD cohort baseline stats (9.9 ± 0.6) are used as the training set is a subset. Overall-phase stats are weighted mean and pooled SD from all HC across datasets (ABCD n=8341, BHRCS n=512, ADHD-200 n=565, ABIDE-II n=329).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 1. Demographic information. ... ABCD ... 9.9 ± 0.6; ABIDE-II ... 12.1 ± 3.2; ADHD-200 ... 11.7 ± 3.0; BHRCS ... 9.9 ± 1.9

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train-phase (ABCD) sex ratio is 52% male. Overall-phase sex ratio is calculated by summing male N from all HC subsets based on dataset-wide male % (ABCD 52.0%, BHRCS 57.1%, ADHD-200 63.1%, ABIDE-II 73.8%).
